title: Refined Baby Llama Eyes
description: Adjusts baby llama eyes for better alignment and improved visual consistency with adult llamas.
body:
# What has changed?

The baby llama eye texture has been subtly adjusted to:
- Improve visual alignment
- Reduce blending with the nose
- Better match the proportions of adult llamas
- The result is a cleaner and more balanced appearance while remaining fully vanilla-friendly.

# Why was it created?
From certain angles, baby llama eyes appear too close to the nose, causing them to visually blend into the face and look slightly misaligned. Compared to adult llamas, the proportions feel inconsistent.

This resource pack refines the eye placement and proportions to create a more natural and cohesive look.

# Impact on gameplay

This pack is purely visual and does not affect gameplay or mechanics in any way. It integrates seamlessly with vanilla textures and is suitable for survival worlds and modpacks.

# Comparison between Vanilla and Refined
